call_points.text: 47 of 100 planned dark stores live at 30 June, 20 more about to go live, across six metro cities.
Amazon has entered the top 10 customer club; Amazon Now is the larger focus of the partnership.
Minimum wage hikes cost ₹2-2.5 Cr a month; diesel pass-through was delayed five days and absorbed.
Dark stores contribute 10-12% of other logistics services revenue; store-level revenue not disclosed.
CriticaLog cross-selling cycle to run 12 months before it grows faster than the core business.
On pricing pressure from anchor customers, management said rate cards already fall as volumes rise.
FY27 capex is expected to remain in absolute terms around ₹180 to ₹190 crores, similar to FY26.
Steady-state EBITDA margin is expected to reach early double digits, with 100 to 120 bps annual improvement till FY28.

guidance.statement: We continue to maintain the same trajectory guidance of 27% to 30% overall business growth.
FY27 revenue growth guidance revised to 38-40% from 27-30%
Margin guidance of 100-200 bps expansion maintained despite faster growth
Prime Large pin code target raised to 12,000 for FY27
Lost shipment debit cost targeted at 3.5-4% of revenue in the long run

operating_notes.text: Shadowfax 360 launched April 21, 2026, targeting SME and D2C seller acquisition across 15,000+ pincodes and 2,500 cities with no minimum order requirements.
Shadowfax operates with a 100% crowdsourced last-mile delivery model on a per-order basis.
Lost shipment debit cost fell to 5.5% of revenue in Q1FY27 from 6.1% in Q4FY26 and 7.9% a year ago, with a long-run target of 3.5-4%.
Prime Large reached 10,000 pin codes in Q1 against a full-year FY27 target and generated about ₹75 Cr ARR, up nearly 170% YoY.
Dark stores: 47 of 100 planned for FY27 live at 30 June across six metro cities, contributing 10-12% of other logistics services revenue.
Board approved a new wholly owned subsidiary in logistics & other services, to be incorporated after MCA approval, with Shadowfax subscribing 100% of initial paid-up capital in cash at par.

timeline.summary: Shadowfax Technologies launched Shadowfax 360, a digital shipping portal for SMEs and D2C brands, on April 21, 2026; it is available immediately.
Abhishek Bansal, Promoter of Shadowfax Technologies Limited, declared no encumbrance on its shares during FY2025-26 under SEBI’s Regulation 31(4).
In May 2026, Shadowfax Technologies passed postal ballot resolutions for ESOP amendments and subsidiary extension.

Shadowfax Technologies Limited schedules a conference call on May 14, 2026, at 5:00 PM IST to discuss Q4 FY26 and FY26 results with **Abhishek Bansal (MD & CEO), Praveen Kumar K J (CFO), and Sachin Dixit (Investor Relations).
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹1,237.09 Cr, net profit ₹55.83 Cr.
Shadowfax Technologies Limited shared the Q4 FY26 earnings conference call recording on May 14, 2026, via its website.
Promoter Vaibhav Khandelwal declared no encumbrance on Shadowfax Technologies shares during FY2025-26 under SEBI’s Regulation 31(4).
In May 2026, Shadowfax Technologies hosted its Q4 FY26 earnings call, reporting FY26 revenue of over ₹4,200 Cr and announcing plans to launch 100 dark stores for vertical quick commerce.

On 16 October 2026, Shadowfax's board approved incorporation of a new wholly owned subsidiary (yet to be incorporated, subject to MCA approval) and allotted 49,098 equity shares under SFX ESOP 2016, raising paid-up capital to ₹586.99 Cr.
Shadowfax Technologies Limited’s Board of Directors will review unaudited standalone and consolidated Q2 & H1 FY27 results on October 29, 2026, with an earnings call at 5:00 PM IST.
